versions.changelog: 纯技能：移除插件，保留五步防跳步与 run-del.sh
防跳步强化：五步锁定+每轮进度追踪；新增 run-del.sh 单命令入口；脚本 [1/5]~[5/5] checklist；明确禁止 ls/抢先 delete/失败后擅自手动删
Dynamic script resolution via find; self-resolving SKILL_DIR inside script; all hardcoded paths removed
Find script via find by filename instead of SKILL.md path; script self-resolves its own directory via dirname $0; all references use DEL_SCRIPT variable for portability
Dynamic skill directory resolution via find (fixes path mismatch between ~/.openclaw/skills/ and ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/); all hardcoded paths replaced with SKILL_DIR variable
Stronger agent behavior constraints in step 4 (must run script, show full output, check phase markers); early mkdir -p for .trash dir; post-delete verification confirms agent outer dir is gone

Explicit bash call in SKILL.md step 4; added 'agent only shows script output' directive to prevent manual overrides; clarified entire outer agent dir must be moved (not subdirs); consolidated fallback steps with mkdir -p for .trash
Bash 3.2 compatibility (temp files replace declare -A); auto-cleanup stale ~/.openclaw/agents/<id>/ dirs after delete; improved manual fallback steps in SKILL.md
修复回收站空目录问题：先 mv 数据到 .trash 再执行 delete，保证数据完整不丢失
回收站从 ~/.Trash/ 改到技能目录下的 .trash/，避免权限问题；.trash 和 history/history.md 加入 .clawignore 防止更新覆盖
初始版本：按照 OpenClaw 官方规范删除 agent，自动移到回收站并记录 history；新增 .clawignore 排除本地记录文件防止更新覆盖
